lines.1: Another day at the executive committee.
lines.3: The Princess and Nagomi are the only two here.
lines.5: Nagomi is doing the accounting with her usual cool composure.
lines.6: 「Ah, Tsushima. Do you know these chocolates?」
lines.7: She shows me a delicious-looking box of what seems to be expensive chocolate.
lines.9: 「They're exceptionally good. You've been working hard lately, so I'll reward you with one.」
lines.14: 「No need to be shy. Hand-feeding one's vassal is important for raising his loyalty.」
lines.16: I-I never dreamed the Princess would say that to me.
lines.18: But this is a reward, so surely romantic complications have nothing to do with it.
lines.27: She pops the chocolate into my mouth.
lines.30: 「Then I'll throw in one more as a bonus.」
lines.38: Don't touch him... Don't touch him... Don't touch him...
lines.39: The echo rings through the student council room.
lines.43: Nagomi hurriedly returns to her work.
